verdict.rationale: A managed server system like the DGX B300, with a BMC and Redfish/IPMI management, could plausibly offer registrable event subscriptions, so the axis applies. The evidence only says Redfish/IPMI management exists. It never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec. Generic management protocols are an adjacent control, not evidence of webhook delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
